title: STEMMA export contract v2.1 (exports/knowledge.json)
description: Consumer contract for the derived export. v2.0 (ADR-0028): the generated inline entities[].relationships projection is REMOVED — the relationship graph is connections[] only. IDs are stemma:-namespaced (ADR-0027). v2.1 (ADR-0032): additive optional relation_registry + vocabularies sidecar. Enforced by scripts/validate.py before the export is written.

export_version.description: Semantic version of the export contract (semver). v2.0.0: stemma: namespace, connections[] is the only relationship source, entities[].relationships removed (ADR-0027/0028).

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the canonical schemas.

relation_registry_version.description: Semver of schema/relation-registry.yaml (ADR-0032, export v2.1.0). Optional; old readers ignore it.

relation_registry.description: Relation name -> {family, inverse, transitive, symmetric, domain, range, status}. Optional sidecar (ADR-0032). Consumers MUST fail closed on an unknown relation when this member is present.

vocabularies.description: Controlled domains/subdomains/regimes/scales mirroring schema/vocabularies/. Optional sidecar (ADR-0032).

claim_signature.description: DERIVED identity of the asserted proposition: sha256(source|relation|target|polarity|sorted qualifiers) (ADR-0026, plan v2 E4.3). Two active connections sharing a signature are a duplicate-claim gate failure. Never stored in canonical YAML.
